Active Omega is the active aspect of Omega. It is manifested in giving love to others and treating them as others. It is necessary for [[Active Alpha]] but active alpha involves creating love while Active Omega merely requires transmitting the love you receive

It corresponds to [[Commandment Omega Alpha]]
